items.title: Derek Brown interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 5, 2021
items.q: I would be interviewing people like Clark Terry, at that level

ctx.x: festivals, in Europe. That’s amazing. And people don’t have to know how many emails I sent, how I did it. But man I sure put it on my website, and hey, international musician. And then hopefully, yes, I can’t send 6,000 emails every year, but hopefully it does get a little bit easier and it has, as your name gets out there. But you have to keep doing the work and this industry has a very short attention span. It seems even shorter now with social media where you’ve got to be putting stuff out all the time. But…

You know some things never change. I recall when we started this project, 25 years ago, that I would be interviewing people like Clark Terry, at that level, and I would be surprised afterwards that some of them would hit me up for a gig. And the reason it surprised me is I just thought, you know being a fan of these guys that by this point in their career they had it made.
